description: This dataset contains geochemical and spatial data for manganese nodule samples collected from various oceanic locations. It records precise coordinates, including latitude, longitude, and elevation, alongside sediment depth measurements. The chemical composition is detailed through concentrations of manganese, iron, nickel, cobalt, and copper. Each entry includes sample identifiers, collection dates, and descriptive notes on nodule morphology, such as whether the sample is a whole nodule or lacks a core. Researchers can utilize this information to analyze the distribution and elemental characteristics of manganese nodules, supporting studies in marine geology and resource exploration.
